features.label: Direct replacement fit
features.text: Designed exclusively for use with the Ossur Formfit Post-Op Knee brace to maintain factory performance.

features.label: Cool or full foam options
features.text: Choose breathable moisture-wicking material for airflow or dense foam for warmth and compression.

features.label: Hygiene and comfort restored
features.text: Replacing soiled or compressed pads ensures optimal padding thickness throughout rehabilitation.

features.label: Precise sizing match
features.text: Available in Regular, XL, and Regular Long to seamlessly fit your specific brace length and leg size.

measurement: Measure thigh circumference 6 in. above mid-patella. Regular and Regular Long sizes fit thigh circumferences up to 27 in. The XL size fits thigh circumferences 27 to 35 in. The Regular Long variant is designed specifically for 24 in. and 28 in. brace lengths. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
